option.name: content
option.value: Use the Conventional Commit format. Use bullet points for multiple changes. Do not use markdown formatting.

task.summary: Update IntelliJ IDEA configuration to include workspace settings, VCS mappings, and database navigator integration

refactor(shared): simplify FrameBroadcaster by replacing condition-based frame management with subscriber queue-based broadcasting
- Add GitToolBox project settings to IntelliJ configuration files.
Update IntelliJ IDEA configuration to reflect changes in workspace settings and GitToolBox integration
refactor(shared): simplify FrameBroadcaster by replacing frame-based logic with subscriber queue model

refactor(shared): enhance FrameBroadcaster with advanced batch retrieval methods and improved logging
- Replace `print` warnings with `loguru` logger for queue full warnings. - Introduce `get_strict_batch`, `get_greedy_batch`, and `get_timed_batch` for flexible frame batch retrieval in asyncio queues.

refactor(object_permanence): update input schema to support batch processing
- Rename `current_frame_b64` to `current_frame_batch_base64` for handling batches of encoded frames. - Adjust imports for better organization.

refactor(object_permanence): update analyze_frame node to support batch processing
- Update prompt text to indicate batch processing of frames. - Replace single frame handling with batch processing using `current_frame_batch_base64`.

refactor(object_permanence): refactor workflow runner to support frame batch processing
- Replace single frame handling with batch processing via `frame_broadcaster`. - Update workflow runner logic to utilize `get_strict_batch` for fetching frames. - Simplify and clean up logging and state update logic. - Remove dependency on `FrameBroadcaster` instance in favor of global `frame_broadcaster`.

chore(ide): update IntelliJ IDEA configuration for workspace and task changes
- Add AIAssistant custom instructions for commit message generation. - Update local task entries with new task summaries and IDs. - Adjust properties component to include updated plugin and workspace settings.

refactor(websockets): update WebSocket handler to support binary frame processing
- Replace text frame handling with binary frame handling and base64 encode frame data. - Update broadcaster to use `broadcast` instead of `publish_frame`. - Improve logging for WebSocket disconnection and unexpected errors. - Ensure WebSocket connections are closed gracefully on errors.

refactor(shared): remove unused FrameBroadcaster instance creation
- Clean up unused `frame_broadcaster = FrameBroadcaster()` declaration to simplify code.

refactor(object_permanence): update workflow runner to require FrameBroadcaster instance
- Modify `object_permanence_workflow_runner` to accept `FrameBroadcaster` as a parameter. - Adjust imports to use the `FrameBroadcaster` class instead of direct instance.

refactor(app): remove frame broadcaster logic from application shutdown process
- Eliminate calls to stop the frame broadcaster during app shutdown. - Simplify logging to focus on critical shutdown tasks.
